citation: Robinson-Smith, L., Menzies, V., Cramman, H., Wang, Y., Bertha, L., Dobson, E., & Tipping, A. (2019). EasyPeasy: Learning through play. Evaluation Report. London: Education Endowment Foundation (EEF). Evaluation conducted by the School of Education, Durham University. (Trial ran Sept 2017-July 2018; report published July 2019. The meta-analysis labels this report 'Robinson-Smith et al. 2018' after the lead evaluator and the 2017/18 trial year.)
report_number: EEF project: EasyPeasy: Learning through play (efficacy trial, July 2019 Evaluation Report). No NCEE number.
design: Two-armed cluster RCT (efficacy); random allocation at the school-nursery level. 102 nursery schools randomised (51 intervention, 51 control); analysis sample 101 nurseries (51 intervention, 50 control) / 1,128 pupils. Children aged 3-4 (Pre-K / pre-Reception) in nine English Local Authorities. Intervention: EasyPeasy home-learning play programme delivered via parents, coordinated within each nursery by a staff 'Pod Leader' trained by EasyPeasy (the TPD/training element coded by the meta-analysis); comparison = business-as-usual. Subject = language/communication. Outcome measured immediately post-intervention (summer 2018, ~20-week programme).
problems: SUBJECT-MAPPING AMBIGUITY: the only achievement outcome is language/communication (CELF Preschool 2 UK). The assignment instruction maps 'early literacy/language -> Reading', so all rows are coded outcome_subject='Reading'; however the broader EXTRACTION_SPEC maps 'writing/language/other -> Other'. If the central merge uses the spec's mapping, these should be re-coded 'Other'. INTERVENTION TYPE: EasyPeasy is primarily a parent-facing home-learning programme; the 'teacher professional development' element is the one-hour online webinar plus dashboard training that nursery 'Pod Leaders' received from EasyPeasy to coordinate parental engagement (consistent with the registry coding: '(P)CK', Short, External trainer). It is a non-standard TPD case but is the study the meta-analysis included as row 99. STANDARDISING SD: the report's Hedges g for the Core Language Standard Score is the pretest-adjusted multilevel impact standardised by the total pooled SD (sqrt(pooled variance 63.8)=7.99); cross-check adj-diff 0.30 / 7.99 = 0.0376 ~ 0.04, matching Table 12. g_se/g_var were derived from the report's reported 95% CIs (SE = CI width / (2*1.95996)); the report does not print SEs directly. The four CELF subscales are components (subscales) of the Core Language Standard Score composite and are reported with their own g; they are extracted as outcome_role='subscale' (the composite Core Language is the primary). Non-achievement secondary outcomes (CSBQ self-regulation/behaviour, HOME home environment) were skipped per spec. Year discrepancy (registry/meta '2018' vs report '2019') resolved: same EEF EasyPeasy trial (2017/18), lead evaluator Lyn Robinson-Smith.

effect_sizes.arm_label: EasyPeasy: Learning through play (parent home-learning programme coordinated by nursery 'Pod Leaders' trained by EasyPeasy) vs business-as-usual
effect_sizes.test_name: CELF Preschool 2 UK - Core Language Standard Score
effect_sizes.g_method: Hedges g reported directly by the report (Table 12, p.36): g=0.04 (95% CI -0.10, 0.18) from a 2-level multilevel mixed-effect linear regression (pupils within nurseries), with baseline Core Language Standard Score and the nursery minimisation factor as fixed effects and nursery as a random effect (-> pretest- and cluster-adjusted). Standardised by the total pooled SD = sqrt(pooled variance 63.8) = 7.99 (Table 14). Cross-check: pretest-adjusted difference in means 0.30 / 7.99 = 0.0376 ~ 0.04. g_se derived from the reported 95% CI: SE = (0.18 - (-0.10)) / (2*1.95996) = 0.07143; g_var = SE^2 = 0.005102.
effect_sizes.notes: Headline/primary confirmatory outcome. No additional months' progress (0 months), p=0.60, not significant. Raw group means (Table 12): intervention 27.3 (95% CI 26.7-28.0), control 26.3 (95% CI 25.6-27.0) on the CELF scaled Core Language Standard Score; SDs not printed for post-test (pooled variance 63.8 from Table 14). n_t/n_c are the n-in-model from Table 12 (1128 total: 562 intervention; 566 control). n_clusters=101 nurseries in the analysis (102 randomised; 51 intervention, 50 control retained). ICC=0.18 (95% CI 0.14-0.24). CELF Preschool 2 UK is an independent, norm-referenced, standardised language assessment administered by trained assessors -> standardized_independent.
